papers.title: EthicalAI: An Evidence-Linked Catalogue of AI Integrity Failures

changelog: Submission roadmap Stage 3: added Figure 1, an inline SVG bar chart of the five-class citation-failure distribution (surface-match dominates), with a caption and an in-text reference. Counts match the Section 3.1 table.
Submission roadmap Stage 2: added a second-model probe. deepseek-chat never declined (0/45, vs gpt-4o's 85%) and fabricated 7 of 8 verified suggestions, reusing one arXiv id across unrelated modes.

The two models fail in opposite styles (over-cautious vs over-confident) but neither produces a citation trustworthy without resolving the source. Abstract, Section 3 probe paragraph, and the probe writeup updated.

Submission roadmap Stage 1: citation integrity sweep. Verified all 12 references resolve to real papers on arXiv (titles, authors, years); fixed Agrawal's author list; confirmed Spracklen's 2025 is the USENIX venue year.
Added a Section 8 note that every reference was resolved to its source before inclusion, the same discipline the paper applies to the catalogue.
Paper-orchestra agent council revision (architect, literature, section writers, integrator, groundedness verifier), validated before publishing.

Promoted the citation-grounding result to its own Section 3 and named the five-class failure typology (surface-match, scope-mismatch, misfiling, polarity-reversal, wrong-population) so it is a citable object.

Positioned against the closest prior work with five arXiv-verified citations: Lewis 2020 (RAG), Rashkin 2021 (AIS attribution), Liu 2023 (verifiability audit), Gao 2023 (ALCE), Agrawal 2023 (reference hallucination).
Added the LLM-citation probe: asked for references, GPT-4o declined on 55 of 65 prompts, and all 10 confident suggestions bound a plausible title to an arXiv id for an unrelated paper.
Converted the keyword/LLM hook from an (ungrounded) analogy into a measured small-probe result; earlier groundedness BLOCK resolved.
Added the citation-failure typology that turns the headline error rate into a diagnosis.
Applied the review council's convergent fixes: reframed 29/50 as a count not a rate, stated the binning rule, added the kappa small-n caveat, fixed a source batch-arithmetic bug.
Reframed to lead with the transferable finding and the reader payoff instead of a flat construction log.
Consolidated the defensive disclaimer cadence flagged by the AI-writing review.
Honest, map-led resource paper: the historical 207-record study, the citation audit, and the verification sweep.
